name: [Bosch HcP - Internship] Production Engineering Intern (Metal Forming & Washing)

location.fullLocation: An Phuoc Commune, Dong Nai, Vietnam

companyDescription.title: Company Description
companyDescription.text: • Bosch first started its operations in Vietnam in 1994 and registered a wholly-owned subsidiary in 2008. According to the business strategy of Bosch in Vietnam, from 1st July 2014 on all business entities were merged into Bosch Vietnam Co. Ltd. with its head office at Ho Chi Minh City plant (HcP) in Dong Nai Province.

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
• Being in charge of daily production monitoring and maintaining.
  • Supporting in documentation control.
  • Supporting data collection and preparing report based on engineer's request.
  • Supporting in doing experimental tests in production floor together with engineers.
  • Assisting engineers in simple admin tasks.
  • Other tasks will be assigned depending on your performance.

qualifications.title: Qualifications
qualifications.text:
• 3rd or 4th-year students major in Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, Industrial Management or any related fields.
  • Proficiency in both English and Vietnamese writing and speaking skill.
  • Be able to adapt international working environment & cultural diversity.
  • Proficient in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Power BI).
  • Enthusiastic, reliable, pro-active, patient and detailed-oriented.

additionalInformation.title: Additional Information
additionalInformation.text:
• A learning-driven, professional, inclusive multinational work environment fosters personal growth and expands professional networks.
  • An attractive monthly allowance.
  • Bus transportation and lunch are provided daily.
  • Full-paid leaves for Vietnam public holidays, birthday, sickness and 01 day per working month.
  • Opportunities to become a Bosch associate after graduation.
